text:
deploy-bot: Deploy paused for release v1.12.0 -> production. Preflight failed: secret encryption policy mismatch detected between staging and prod (inference cache secrets). See /deploy/preflight (run id: 8f3a). Please triage.

maya: ack — what's the exact mismatch?

sam: quick summary: staging is using local-cleartext/no-encryption; prod expects KMS-wrapped AES-GCM. Key: secrets.encryption setting differs.

sam: diff snippet:
```yaml
# staging overlay (current)
secrets:
  encryption: "none"

# prod overlay (expected)
secrets:
  encryption: "kms:aes-gcm"
  kms_key: "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyR1"
```

anika: that's from the onboarding script that didn't apply the KMS overlay to staging. Options: 1) patch staging to match prod and re-run preflight (~10m), 2) temporarily tell deploybot to skip this check for this run (not recommended), 3) hold and roll back this release to the previous tag and open a backport PR.

ryan: change window closes in ~50m. I prefer patching staging and re-running preflight so we can keep momentum. Also we should pin the model-serving image for this release to avoid unrelated drift.

maya: +1 to patch staging. I'll add a note to the release notes explaining the staging preflight mismatch and the short KMS patch. No customer-facing impact.

sam: I'm on the patch. Plan: update staging kustomize overlay, apply, then re-run deploybot preflight. Commands:
```bash
kubectl -n infra apply -f overlays/staging/secrets-encryption.yaml
deploybot preflight run-id 8f3a --revalidate\```

anika: post-patch, run smoke tests on inference cache and kv-store. If any test fails, ping @oncall and we abort. Add the change to ops checklist.

deploy-bot: Re-run preflight triggered by sam (run-id 8f3a-r1). Will update thread with pass/fail.

sam: patch applied, preflight re-run in progress. smoke tests queued.

sam: preflight now passes. staging overlay updated to use KMS; smoke tests are green for cache warmup and kv-store.

maya: decision: proceed with promote to prod once release notes merged and image pin confirmed. Release notes entry: "Patched staging encryption to match prod KMS; no customer impact. Image pinned to v2026-03-18." @ryan to merge.

ryan: merging release notes and tagging release `v1.12.0-prod-20260321`. Also pinning model image to `v2026-03-18`. :shipit: 

sam: will watch prod promotion and standby for rollback if needed. Closing thread after deploy completes.

deploy-bot: Promotion started -> prod. Will post final status on completion.
